interpretation: M2.73 is a conservative stitch-type texture step. It does not claim a large executability improvement over M2.72; instead, it safely promotes two shape/icon samples to satin-like outputs while preserving zero hard_fail, zero visible connectors, and no jump/trim/off-mask increases.
remaining_bottlenecks: Most satin-like candidates are still rejected because they increase jump, trim, off-mask, or precision risk.
The texture model is candidate-gated and deterministic, not yet a learned stitch-type planner.
Professional digitizing still requires true satin/tatami/running stitch segmentation, underlay, pull compensation, thread-density control, and 3D render-back texture metrics.
